questions.q: What is the fundamental relationship between the Azure Portal and the Azure CLI?
options: The CLI can do things the Portal fundamentally cannot do
The Portal is only for viewing resources, the CLI is required to create anything
They connect to two different, separate versions of Azure
Both talk to the exact same Azure — the difference is typing commands vs. clicking through menus, not what's possible
questions.explain: Neither is "more powerful" in terms of what's possible — the difference is how you interact with the same underlying Azure.

questions.q: Why does "scriptable" matter more than just being faster to type?
options: A scripted command can be saved and rerun any time, including as part of an automated pipeline, without manual clicking
It only matters for security, not for repeatability
Scripted commands run faster on Azure's servers
Scriptable commands don't require an Azure subscription
questions.explain: The real value is reuse and automation, not just saving a few clicks on a single run.

questions.q: What does the `az login` command do?
options: Creates a new resource group
Lists every virtual machine in a subscription
Deletes a subscription
Signs you in by opening a browser to authenticate
questions.explain: az login handles authentication — the same identity concept covered in Lesson 9's Entra ID.

questions.q: In `az group create --name rg-demo --location eastus`, what does `--location eastus` represent?
options: The action being performed
The name of the Azure CLI tool itself
An authentication token
A parameter specifying which region to create the resource group in
questions.explain: Almost every Azure CLI command follows the shape: az <service> <action> --<parameter> <value>.

questions.q: What does "repeatable" mean about a CLI command, as described in this lesson?
options: Running the same command multiple times produces the same result each time, with no chance of a misclick
The command automatically repeats itself every hour
Repeatable commands cannot include parameters
The command can only be run exactly once
questions.explain: The tenth run of a saved CLI command creates exactly the same thing as the first run.
